classification: User-requested ad block; no malware classification
method: Native rule matching with inert URL strings; pop-up and generated-video tests used loopback fixtures and a deny-all external proxy in disposable browser profiles.
activation: Reload Module Engine (BlockAds) to load the updated static ad rule.
notes: The initial sandbox browser launch failed before assertions. The same fixture passed with the required process access.
A pre-existing test assumed the site-host catalog was the only extra ad source. Its count assertion now accounts for the independent user-requested catalog, and all 237 checks pass.
Focused checks establish exact-host matching, overrides, ad-layer toggling, play/hover protection, normal link behavior and guard disable/reload. They do not establish universal live-site coverage.
